title: hedyotis capitellata var. glabra
intro: Hedyotis capitellata var. glabra, commonly known as Downy Buttonweed, is a perennial herb belonging to the Rubiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Hedyotis capitellata var. glabra are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
